findings.reason: Wait zero fast path and semaphore release in Add support both event orders, subject to scheduling.
Done delegates to Add(-1), atomic state becomes negative before panic; subsequent Wait attempts semaphore wait if no changes.
Add detects positive increment while waiters remain; Wait later checks state after semaphore acquire, permitting stated race windows.
Go calls Add before launching and its deferred wrapper calls Done after normal return or Goexit; nested Go documented.
